newsitem.title: KENYA: Eritrea says 15 Sudanese troops killed in attack.
newsitem.headline: Eritrea says 15 Sudanese troops killed in attack.

text.p: A Sudanese rebel group killed 15 government soldiers in an attack on a military post near the eastern city of Kassala on Friday, Eritrean radio, monitored in Nairobi, reported.
"The Sudanese Alliance Forces yesterday launched an attack on a Sudanese government military post, 15 kilometres east of Kassala," the radio on Saturday quoted the group as saying.

"During the operation, the Alliance Forces killed 15 government soldiers and wounded five others. They took control of the post for a short period and withdrew to their areas without any losses," it said.
The operation was carried out "in support of the ongoing uprisings in Khartoum and to promote people's armed uprisings in Sudan," the radio added.

Eritrea, Africa's newest state, which broke away from Ethiopia in 1993 and has a common border with the Sudan, supports Sudanese groups fighting to bring down the National Islamic Front (NIF) government in Khartoum. Eritrean leaders say the NIF is trying to destabilise the region.
